Hi Alex — thanks for signing up and for the clear questions. Quick answers up front, and I can walk through details on the call: 

- Private repos: we recommend installing our GitHub App for org-level access (more secure, token refresh handled by the app).
- Webhooks: youll need repo and pull_request scopes for real-time triggers; we can supply a minimal scope list for auditors.
- Rate limits: we have per-customer throttles and an ingestion backoff policy — for ~3k repos we usually recommend a staged rollout and continuous batching settings (Ill share our integration checklist).

I attached our short integration checklist to this thread — it calls out required scopes and suggested rollout cadence. Would any of these slots work?

- Thu 13 May: 10:30 CEST or 11:30 CEST
- Fri 14 May: 10:00 CEST

If those dont fit, heres a quick calendar link: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min

Ive looped in Aditya (SDR) to help confirm logistics and Marissa (integration engineer) to join for a short technical deep-dive if needed.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference
